label: Film reference · 2009
approvedText: In the 2009 television film Prayers for Bobby, based on Mary Griffith’s life, a mother’s address to a city council asks adults to consider how their words reach the children listening. A related appeal emerges from Chen Chun-ju’s own experience of loss: her public words turn toward protecting other children and affirming their right to be themselves.
